question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Lake Baikal is a massive freshwater lake covering 31,500 sq. km. It is 636 km long and has an average width of 48 km, with the (a) ------- point measuring 79.4 km. Its basin holds around 23,000 cubic kilometers of water, which accounts for one fifth of the world’s (b) ------- surface water. The lake’s average depth is 730 meters, but at its deepest point, it reaches 1,620 meters. Interestingly, it would take nearly one year for all the rivers in the world to fill the basin, but it would take around 400 years for the current rivers flowing into it to do the (c) -------. There are many hot (d) ------- around the lake, known for their excellent water quality. Lake Baikal is also known for its storms, especially in (e) ------- when strong winds blow in many directions. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) widest; (b) fresh; (c) same; (d) springs; (e) autumn;
